elements.name: Dataset Discovery and Identification
elements.description: Can a user or system discover and uniquely identify this dataset?

sub_elements.name: Persistent Identifier (DOI, RRID, etc.)
sub_elements.quality_note: Valid, properly formatted PhysioNet DOI serving as both id and doi.

sub_elements.name: Dataset Title and Description Completeness
sub_elements.evidence: title: Bridge2AI-Voice - An ethically-sourced, diverse voice dataset linked to health information; description spans ~1500 chars covering purpose, modalities, participant counts, and access model.
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear title plus a comprehensive, well-beyond-200-char description explaining purpose, scope, and structure.

sub_elements.name: Keywords or Tags for Searchability
sub_elements.evidence: keywords: [voice biomarker, acoustic biomarker, Bridge2AI, voice disorders, neurological disorders, ... OpenSMILE, Praat, BIDS, PhysioNet, b2aiprep] (~50 terms)
sub_elements.quality_note: ~50 relevant keywords spanning domain, conditions, methods, tools, and standards.

sub_elements.name: Dataset Landing Page or Platform URL
sub_elements.evidence: page: https://docs.b2ai-voice.org; external_resources PhysioNet https://physionet.org/content/b2ai-voice/
sub_elements.quality_note: Active documentation and PhysioNet landing pages provided.

sub_elements.name: Associated Project or Program
sub_elements.evidence: keywords include Bridge2AI; funders: 'NIH Common Fund Bridge2AI Program'; external_resources: Bridge2AI Program https://bridge2ai.org
sub_elements.quality_note: Explicit, repeated association with the NIH Bridge2AI program.

elements.name: Dataset Access and Retrieval
elements.description: Can the dataset and its associated resources be located, accessed, and downloaded?

sub_elements.name: Access Mechanism Defined
sub_elements.evidence: license_and_use_terms: 'Only registered users who sign the specified Data Use Agreement ... can access files. Raw audio available through controlled access only via Data Access Compliance Office (DACO)'
sub_elements.quality_note: Two-tier access (registered access for features, controlled access for raw audio) clearly stated.

sub_elements.name: Data Use Agreement Required?
sub_elements.evidence: subsets: 'complete a Data Access Request Form (DARF), Data Use Agreement (DUA), and institutional Data Use and Transfer Agreement (DTUA) signed by authorized official'
sub_elements.quality_note: DUA/DTUA requirement and signing process explicitly documented, including contact DACO@b2ai-voice.org.

sub_elements.name: Download URL or Platform Link Available
sub_elements.evidence: version_access: https://physionet.org/content/b2ai-voice/; controlled-access request via mailto:DACO@b2ai-voice.org
sub_elements.quality_note: Platform access URLs and controlled-access request instructions both present.

sub_elements.name: File Formats Specified
sub_elements.evidence: distribution_formats: Parquet (spectrograms/derived features), TSV/JSON (phenotype/static features), WAV (BIDS-structured raw audio)
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific formats given with structural detail and BIDS v1.9.0 compliance.

sub_elements.name: External Links to Similar or Related Datasets
sub_elements.evidence: external_resources: Health Data Nexus, Zenodo archive, b2aiprep, SenseLab, REDCap dictionary, NIH RePORTER, Interspeech publication
sub_elements.quality_note: Rich set of related repositories, platforms, and resource links.

elements.name: Data Reuse and Interoperability
elements.description: Is sufficient information provided to reuse and integrate the dataset with others?

sub_elements.name: License Terms Allow Reuse
sub_elements.evidence: license: Bridge2AI Voice Registered Access License; 'Commercial and non-commercial research use permitted for Authorized Researchers.'
sub_elements.quality_note: License named with explicit reuse scope (research use, no export controls).

sub_elements.name: Data Formats Are Standardized
sub_elements.evidence: Parquet, TSV, JSON, WAV; 'BIDS v1.9.0 compliant structure'
sub_elements.quality_note: Standard, tool-compatible formats used consistently.

sub_elements.name: Schema or Ontology Conformance Stated
sub_elements.evidence: 'BIDS v1.9.0 compliant format'; diagnostic labels 'Per Bridge2AI protocols and ICD-10 codes'; FAIR and CARE principles referenced
sub_elements.quality_note: No dedicated conforms_to field, but BIDS v1.9.0, ICD-10, and FAIR/CARE conformance are explicitly and repeatedly stated.

sub_elements.name: Identifiers Defined for Linking
sub_elements.evidence: distribution_formats: 'Each element contains participant_id, session_id, task_name'; BIDS path sub-{participant_id}/ses-{session_id}/...
sub_elements.quality_note: Explicit linking keys (participant_id, session_id, task_name) defined for cross-file joining.

sub_elements.name: Documentation of Processing Tools for Reproducibility
sub_elements.evidence: b2aiprep (Apache-2.0, https://github.com/sensein/b2aiprep), SenseLab, OpenSMILE eGeMaps, Parselmouth/Praat, torchaudio, Whisper
sub_elements.quality_note: Named processing pipeline and open-source code repositories provided.

elements.name: Ethical Use and Privacy Safeguards
elements.description: Does the dataset provide clear information about consent, privacy, and ethical oversight?

sub_elements.name: IRB or Ethics Review Documented
sub_elements.evidence: human_subject_research.irb_approval: 'University of South Florida Single IRB approval with subsite IRB approvals through Single IRB process'; Study ID: OT2OD032720
sub_elements.quality_note: IRB oversight with named institution, Single IRB model, and study ID documented.

sub_elements.name: Deidentification Method Described
sub_elements.evidence: is_deidentified: 'HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification applied. All direct identifiers removed ... Dates rebased: Yes. K-anonymization: No.'
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific HIPAA Safe Harbor method with itemized treatment of identifier classes.

sub_elements.name: Identifiers Removed or Masked
sub_elements.evidence: cleaning_strategies: 'removed direct identifiers (names, civic addresses, social security numbers), indirect identifiers ... sensitive information (household income, mental health status, ...)'
sub_elements.quality_note: Detailed enumeration of removed direct, indirect, and sensitive identifiers.

sub_elements.name: Informed Consent Obtained from Participants
sub_elements.evidence: collection_consents: 'All participants duly informed and provided prospective informed consent for data collection and use via IRB-approved consent process.'
sub_elements.quality_note: Prospective informed consent process described, including scope and withdrawal rights.

sub_elements.name: Ethical Sourcing Statement Included
sub_elements.evidence: ethical_reviews: 'Bioethics guidance integrated throughout study design and conduct by consortium bioethicists ... develops new guidelines for consenting to voice data collection, sharing, and utilization'
sub_elements.quality_note: Explicit ethical-sourcing narrative reinforced by 'ethically sourced' framing throughout and dedicated ethics module.

elements.name: Data Composition and Structure
elements.description: Can the dataset's structure, modality, and population be understood from metadata?

sub_elements.name: Cohort or Population Characteristics Described
sub_elements.evidence: instances + subpopulations: six cohorts (Voice, Neurological, Mood/Psychiatric, Respiratory, Pediatric, Controls) with inclusion criteria and validation methods
sub_elements.quality_note: Rich cohort descriptions with demographics, age ranges, and clinical inclusion criteria.

sub_elements.name: Number of Participants or Samples Reported
sub_elements.evidence: instances.counts: 833; description: '~61,937 voice-derived recordings from 833 adult participants'; pediatric v1.0 300 participants
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific participant and recording counts across releases.

sub_elements.name: Modalities or Data Types Listed
sub_elements.evidence: acquisition_methods: voice/speech acoustic tasks, questionnaires, EHR, imaging (laryngoscopy, stroboscopy, MRI, CT), genomics
sub_elements.quality_note: Multiple modalities enumerated (audio, phenotype, imaging, genomic, EHR).

sub_elements.name: Conditions or Phenotypes Represented
sub_elements.evidence: subpopulations detail conditions: laryngeal cancer, Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, ALS, depression, schizophrenia, airway stenosis, chronic cough, pediatric speech disorders
sub_elements.quality_note: Extensive, specific phenotype listing per cohort with diagnostic subtypes.

sub_elements.name: File Dimensions or Sampling Rates Provided
sub_elements.evidence: preprocessing_strategies: 'resampling to 16 kHz'; spectrograms '513xN dimensions'; MFCC '60xN'; FFT '25ms window, 10ms hop, 512-point'
sub_elements.quality_note: Concrete sampling rates and array dimensions provided.

elements.name: Data Provenance and Version Tracking
elements.description: Can a user determine dataset versions, update history, and provenance?

sub_elements.name: Dataset Version Number Provided
sub_elements.evidence: version: "3.0.0"
sub_elements.quality_note: Explicit semantic version present.

sub_elements.name: Version History Documented
sub_elements.evidence: distribution_dates: 'v1.0 January 17, 2025 (306 participants, 12,523 recordings); v1.1 ...; v2.0.0 April 16, 2025; v2.0.1 August 18, 2025; v3.0.0 ...'
sub_elements.quality_note: Full versioned release timeline documented.

sub_elements.name: Change Descriptions for Each Version
sub_elements.evidence: updates: 'v1.1 added MFCC features'; counts grow from 306 to 833 participants across versions
sub_elements.quality_note: Per-version change notes and growth described.

sub_elements.name: Update Schedule or Frequency Indicated
sub_elements.evidence: updates: 'Dataset updated with versioned static releases semi-annually ... Data collection ongoing through November 30, 2026. Target: 10,000 participants by 2027.'
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear semi-annual release cadence and roadmap.

sub_elements.name: Versioned Documentation or External References
sub_elements.evidence: version_access: 'All dataset versions available through PhysioNet ... with version-specific DOIs ... Each version has unique DOI.'
sub_elements.quality_note: Version-specific DOIs and hosting policy documented.

elements.name: Scientific Motivation and Funding Transparency
elements.description: Does the metadata clearly state why the dataset exists and who funded it?

sub_elements.name: Motivation or Rationale for Dataset Creation
sub_elements.evidence: purposes + addressing_gaps: 'Address the lack of large, high quality, multi-institutional and diverse voice databases linked to multimodal health biomarkers ...'
sub_elements.quality_note: Detailed scientific rationale and enumerated research gaps addressed.

sub_elements.name: Primary Research Objective or Task
sub_elements.evidence: tasks: 7 specific AI/ML tasks (voice-disorder, neurological, mood, respiratory, pediatric screening, workforce development, model pretraining/benchmarking)
sub_elements.quality_note: Concrete primary tasks and intended ML use cases specified.

sub_elements.name: Funding Source or Grant Agency Listed
sub_elements.evidence: funders: 'National Institutes of Health (NIH) Common Fund Bridge2AI Program'; 'National Institute of Biomedical Imaging and Bioengineering (NIBIB)'
sub_elements.quality_note: Named funding agencies with administering institute and study section.

sub_elements.name: Award Number or Grant ID Present
sub_elements.evidence: funders: 'Grant number: 3OT2OD032720-01S3. Opportunity Number: OTA-21-008'; NIBIB 'R01EB030362'
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific award numbers for both funding streams.

sub_elements.name: Acknowledgement of Platform or Participant Support
sub_elements.evidence: funders acknowledge PhysioNet/MIT LCP support; participant_compensation details gift-card compensation; maintainers credit T-CAIREM and PhysioNet
sub_elements.quality_note: Platform and participant support acknowledged with concrete detail.

elements.name: Technical Transparency (Data Collection and Processing)
elements.description: Can data collection and processing steps be replicated or understood?

sub_elements.name: Collection Setting or Sites Described
sub_elements.evidence: data_collectors: 'Research teams at each of the five North American collection sites'; pediatric 'exclusively from Hospital for Sick Children (SickKids)'; specialty high-volume expert clinics
sub_elements.quality_note: Collection settings and site model described, including named pediatric site.

sub_elements.name: Data Capture Method or Device Listed
sub_elements.evidence: collection_mechanisms: 'custom Bridge2AI-Voice App on iPad (9th or 10th generation) or iPad Air (5th generation) with Avid AE-36 microphone and Apple dongle connector'
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific hardware, microphone, and capture app documented.

sub_elements.name: Preprocessing or Cleaning Steps Documented
sub_elements.evidence: preprocessing_strategies (8 items) and cleaning_strategies (4 items) detail resampling, FFT spectrograms, MFCC, feature extraction, Whisper transcription, BIDS conversion, and audit QC
sub_elements.quality_note: Extensive, reproducible preprocessing and cleaning pipeline.

sub_elements.name: Open-Source Processing Code Provided
sub_elements.evidence: b2aiprep (https://github.com/sensein/b2aiprep, Apache-2.0), SenseLab (https://github.com/sensein/senselab), REDCap dictionary repo
sub_elements.quality_note: Public code repositories with licenses linked.

sub_elements.name: External Standards or References Cited
sub_elements.evidence: citation: Bensoussan et al., Interspeech 2024 (DOI 10.21437/Interspeech.2024-1926); BIDS v1.9.0; ICD-10; Zenodo/NIH RePORTER references
sub_elements.quality_note: Published paper and multiple external standards cited.

elements.name: Dataset Evaluation and Limitations Disclosure
elements.description: Does the metadata communicate known risks, biases, or dataset limitations?

sub_elements.name: Limitations Section Present
sub_elements.evidence: sampling_strategies.why_not_representative lists six limitations; 'Not representative of general population due to limited geographic locations and clinic-based recruitment'
sub_elements.quality_note: No dedicated 'limitations' field, but substantive, explicit limitations are documented within sampling strategy and discouraged/prohibited uses.

sub_elements.name: Sampling Bias or Representativeness Noted
sub_elements.evidence: is_representative: false; why_not_representative: 'Clinic-based recruitment introduces selection bias toward treatment-seeking populations'; 'Public releases do not contain equal distribution across disease categories'
sub_elements.quality_note: Sampling bias and representativeness limitations explicitly and thoroughly discussed.

sub_elements.name: Quality Control or Validation Steps Mentioned
sub_elements.evidence: cleaning_strategies: 'missingness tables generated ...; distribution and outlier checks; categorical responses checked against schema; audio quality control metrics including silence amount, duration, and speech-to-passage accuracy'
sub_elements.quality_note: Concrete QC/audit protocol described with named toolkits.

sub_elements.name: Known Risks or Use Constraints Listed
sub_elements.evidence: discouraged_uses (hiring/insurance/surveillance, re-identification) and prohibited_uses; sensitive_elements note voice re-identification and voice AI hacking risks
sub_elements.quality_note: Discouraged and prohibited uses plus enumerated privacy/security risks.

sub_elements.name: Conflicts of Interest Declared
sub_elements.evidence: No conflict-of-interest statement found in ethics/human_subject_research or elsewhere.
sub_elements.quality_note: No explicit COI declaration present.

elements.name: Cross-Platform and Community Integration
elements.description: Does the dataset connect to wider data ecosystems, repositories, or standards?

sub_elements.name: Dataset Published on a Recognized Platform
sub_elements.evidence: maintainers/version_access: PhysioNet (MIT LCP) as primary platform; Health Data Nexus (T-CAIREM, University of Toronto) as alternative
sub_elements.quality_note: Published on recognized biomedical data platforms.

sub_elements.name: Cross-referenced DOIs or Related Dataset Links
sub_elements.evidence: external_resources: Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.13834653; Interspeech DOI 10.21437/Interspeech.2024-1926; NIH RePORTER project 11376382
sub_elements.quality_note: Multiple cross-referenced DOIs and related-work links.

sub_elements.name: Community Standards or Schema Reference
sub_elements.evidence: keywords + text: BIDS (Brain Imaging Data Structure), FAIR principles, CARE principles, ICD-10
sub_elements.quality_note: References to established community standards and schemas.

sub_elements.name: Associated Outreach Materials
sub_elements.evidence: external_resources: Bridge2AI Voice Scholars Training (b2aivoicescholars.org), project documentation; existing_uses: Summer School and hackathon
sub_elements.quality_note: Training programs, documentation, and educational events documented.

sub_elements.name: Similar Dataset Links or Thematic Grouping
sub_elements.evidence: Bridge2AI Program parent (bridge2ai.org); pediatric dataset released separately; extension_mechanism describes derivative datasets on Health Data Nexus
sub_elements.quality_note: Thematic grouping within Bridge2AI and related/derivative dataset pathways.

strengths: Exceptional composition detail: six clinical cohorts with specific diagnostic subtypes, participant/recording counts, and gold-standard validation methods per cohort.
Complete access and licensing model documenting a two-tier registered/controlled access scheme with DUA, DARF, and institutional DTUA requirements and DACO contact.

Highly reproducible technical pipeline: named capture hardware (iPad, Avid AE-36), quantitative preprocessing parameters (16 kHz, 513xN spectrograms, 60xN MFCC), and open-source code (b2aiprep, SenseLab).
Strong provenance and versioning: full release timeline (v1.0 through v3.0.0), semi-annual cadence, and version-specific DOIs.
Thorough ethics and privacy documentation: HIPAA Safe Harbor with itemized identifier handling, IRB study ID, Certificate of Confidentiality, prospective informed consent, and pediatric protections.
weaknesses: No explicit conflict-of-interest declaration despite a large multi-institutional consortium.
Limitations are distributed across sampling_strategies and use-restriction fields rather than consolidated in a dedicated limitations section.
No formal conforms_to field; schema/standard conformance (BIDS, ICD-10, FAIR/CARE) is inferred from free-text rather than a structured slot.
Certain funder/participant acknowledgements are embedded in prose rather than a dedicated acknowledgements field.
recommendations: Add an explicit conflicts_of_interest statement for consortium investigators and clinical sites.
Consolidate representativeness caveats, QC caveats, and use constraints into a single dedicated limitations block for discoverability.
Populate a structured conforms_to field enumerating BIDS v1.9.0, ICD-10, FAIR, and CARE for machine-readable interoperability.
Add a dedicated acknowledgements field summarizing platform (PhysioNet, Health Data Nexus) and participant contributions.
